I added the `shipping <customer>` command and listed it in `help` directly after `balance <customer>`. `dotnet test Billing.slnx` passes (8 of 8), and the work and `.work/report.json` are committed.

Logistics still needs to decide what the charge should be for unlisted regions; I recorded this as an open question in the report.
